property: With no assurance row on record the band reads under 13 with co-sign, at every place that reads it.
A minor may hold a set of live guardians, and a per-act co-sign counts M of that set.
A community-scope act by an identity read at 13 to 15 is admitted only with a guardian's co-sign, whatever envelope is set.
A guardian's own exit takes one signature; adding or removing another guardian is never a lone act.
The teen threshold is the solo-autonomy threshold of 16.
An agent bears no reporting duty of its own; it defers the report and its steward bears the duty.
Any one guardian narrows a widening the set co-signed; widening again takes the set.
No incapacity binding is plenary, whatever a policy sets.
The capacity assessor is neither the steward nor the petitioner.
A binding with no champion distinct from steward, assessor and petitioner, or with a minor as steward, is refused.
The emergency doctrine is tier T0 and gives no steward standing; reversible_pending is admissible from T1.
With no capacity row on record the person reads as having capacity.
A binding row that names no petitioner is refused.
A binding whose valid_until outruns the review cadence, or whose attester is the steward or the petitioner, is refused.
A lineage witness is admitted by being listed, whatever its identity_type.
A new edge naming a head other than the one it must name is refused in every mode.
A halt's reach is judged at each node's latch instant and never at the signer's asserted_at.
A halt row reaching a node after its valid_until has one stated effect (it fires or it does not), the same at every node.
The fuse counts from each node's own receipt, so a confirmation late at one node confirms nothing there.
Every accord threshold is counted over the standing roster and never over a fixed three.
A holder is seated only by a recorded strict majority of the standing roster.
Confirm and resume take the same strict majority of the standing roster.
An entrenched change takes the accord ratification in addition to the five amendment steps, never in place of them.
An item exactly at the threshold reads below the floor; the predicate has two values.
Revocation forces an item below the floor unless it is erasure-exempt, under legal hold, or the signer's kept copy at self scope.
Every EjectionVerdict value has a disposition.
Root conferral takes a strict majority of the standing accord roster, as pipeline blessing does.
Every object an accord holder signs is in the accord's enumeration.
The holder key records the bundle serves are exactly those the roster counts, and no backstop key exists.
Below a strict majority the survivors can fire a halt and can neither confirm nor resume one.
No holder serves the bytes while an admitted notice stands.
Every basis marked Immediate is destroyed on receipt at every holder, on the storage side as on the serving side.
An immediate-removal notice destroys on receipt; a steward_purge dwells W before hard deletion.
A duty-holder's takedown and a steward_purge differ in admission, reach and timing.
A slash act is admitted only under the enforced admission test, as every other duty act is.
A duty act is admitted only if every edge is scoped and the chain reaches an accountable root; an absent field never admits.
The person named in any record, a good-faith warning included, sees that it exists, its kind, what follows and who answers for it.
The frame and the device class are fixed for the fleet; a node sets only whether it offers shaping.
A node with shaping off gives a shaped link at its device class to a peer that asks.
Every class of the budget table, seat included, is an offer.
A peer past the eight-link bound is admitted by displacement or refused, never run below its class.
The hold after the last real frame is the operator's value with a ten-minute default, never a ceiling.
Large is more than 64 KiB by the file's whole size, a bound apart from the 1 MiB envelope cap.
Every named configuration key bounds a quantity some section defines.
Every revision condition names its mechanical evaluator.
The register holds two kinds of entry: privileges with all four cells, and entrenched structure listed for visibility.
The entrenchment quorum is a strict majority of the standing accord roster and is never set lower.
Every scope kind of the table, license and grant included, takes the enforced admission test.
The closed set of infra scopes is the same eight tokens wherever it is listed.
slash is a scope kind in the home table and in every duty scope set that admission reads.
The agency gate reads whether the role set contains node, never whether the key is node-only.
A delegated act is signed by the agent occurrence key and is never read as the user's own signature.
A key_grant is admitted only from an issuer that owns or stewards the asset or holds a grant-scoped delegation over it; possession alone is refused.
A delegation past its valid_until is dead with the cascade of a withdrawal, and a renewal is a fresh conferral.
A founder seat moves by a recorded ceremony or by the one bounded recovery widening while the root is stalled, and by nothing else.
A targeted row naming a third party, and an acceptance already consumed, are each refused.
Leaving is the member's own membership:resignation row.
An owner binding written at self may be re-signed wider as a second row, and a serve-seat node's or an open joiner's stands at federation scope.
A steward-bound agent's acceptance is signed by the agent's own key; the binding is a precondition and never the vote.
A unanimous removal is signed by every other member, and those signers are a strict majority.
The epoch DEK is derived from the exporter secret, and the exporter secret is never wrapped.
A stream is kept by the producer's choice, read from history_on_join full or from the wraps.
A stream epoch advances on every add; the community epoch DEK rotates on removal and never on admission.
The community epoch DEK is wrapped to every current member; a stream DEK is wrapped only for a kept stream.
A chain-judged row older than W is refused whatever its signer's standing.
A row whose asserted_at is past the future bound is refused under one named token.
The freshness window is 72 hours for every row; only a proposal's own window_until reaches seven days.
No rule reads a clock other than a peer's own synchronised UTC clock.
Every case, separator or ordering variant of a wrap_algorithm string is refused as unknown.
Un-announcing retires the federation row and leaves the self row as it was.
owner_of folds every live binding; an announcement supersedes none of the narrower rows.
A peer holds every owner binding whose scope it is in: federation for a stranger, the group's for a group peer, the addressed one for a contact.
Nobody holds the moderate duty without the members' signed votes and their own acceptance.
A private report opens no window; only an action raised in the room defaults to removal at the window's end.
